title: Evening Flock — Begin two slow rings with following or opposed flights
help: All eighty birds start in the same two rings. Quarter-speed tangents follow together, reverse together, or oppose each other. The speed is a starting condition, not a promise of continued circling. Starting clears beat history and leaves the sky paused.
rows: Both rings take quarter-speed forward flights
Both rings take quarter-speed backward flights
message: rings experiments keep their distinct rules and exact supplied choices
facts: Use only seedScene pairedFlights map. For i0..79,j=i%40,t=2πj/40,x=(i<40?350:650)+110cos(t),y=300+110sin(t),vx=−2k sin(t),vy=2k cos(t). k from exact row. Speed magnitude=.5; coordinates/tangents are compared in Chromium not Node; normalize JSON negative zero only.
noteFallback: Other choices keep their existing descriptions.
notes: Both tangents follow the forward direction at a starting speed of half a world unit per beat. The two rings still begin with forty birds each.
Both tangents point backward at the same starting speed of half a world unit per beat. Reversing flights does not reflect or reorder the eighty places.
The left ring follows forward and the right ring follows backward, each at half a world unit per beat. These opposed starting flights do not guarantee a stationary ring shape.
